steps.title: Browse the catalog
steps.detail: The catalog page loads products and categories. React applies category, brand and name/SKU filters to the loaded products.

steps.title: Build a local draft
steps.detail: Add to Quote updates the browser cart. The context uses a guest key or a per-user key. Draft changes do not create a quote record.

steps.title: Calculate the estimate
steps.detail: Quantity 10 or more selects a configured bulk price. The cart estimates discounts, tax and shipping from user data and configured application rates. These are estimates, not a tax-compliance guarantee.

steps.title: Submit a quote request
steps.detail: The route checks the session and creates Quote and QuoteItem records for the signed-in user. This was reviewed in code; no quote was submitted during the recording.

steps.title: Review and adjust stock
steps.detail: The status-update route checks ADMIN access. Entering APPROVED decreases stock; leaving APPROVED restores it. The quote update and stock changes run in one Prisma transaction. This is not a claim of concurrency-safe reservation.

steps.title: Resolve the customer ledger
steps.detail: The route finds the ledger by customer name or creates it. This lookup/create happens before the grouped invoice transaction.

steps.title: Create invoice and items
steps.detail: The transaction creates a Sale with invoice number, totals and related SaleItem records. Values are supplied by the entry form; this diagram is not a financial validation guarantee.

steps.title: Decrease stock
steps.detail: For each product the route calculates cases times units-per-case plus pieces, then decrements stock. This code path does not include free units in that deduction.

steps.title: Post receivable and balance
steps.detail: A SALE voucher records the invoice amount as a debit and the customer ledger balance is incremented. Invoice, item, stock, voucher and balance writes are grouped in the transaction.

steps.title: Resolve the supplier
steps.detail: The supplier ledger is found or created before the purchase transaction. Purchase entry is independent of the customer quote workflow.

steps.title: Record purchase and items
steps.detail: The route creates the Purchase record and its PurchaseItem lines with invoice, quantities, rates and tax fields.

steps.title: Increase stock
steps.detail: The purchase route increments stock using cases times units-per-case, piece quantity and free quantity.

steps.title: Post the supplier payable
steps.detail: A PURCHASE voucher records a credit. The supplier balance decreases by the purchase amount. A negative ledger balance represents the payable in this implementation.

steps.title: Choose the voucher type
steps.detail: The ERP exposes receipts, payments and vouchers as entry screens. The route receives account, debit, credit, particulars and optional references.

steps.title: Calculate net movement
steps.detail: The route calculates netChange as debit minus credit. These are account ledger entries; this code does not demonstrate a complete double-entry general ledger.

steps.title: Write voucher and balance
steps.detail: The transaction stores the voucher and increments the ledger balance by netChange. Financial actions were not executed on the live system for the video.

steps.title: Establish a customer session
steps.detail: The authentication callback checks the supplied credentials and places the user ID and role in the token and session. Customer sign-in was verified with the owner-provided account.

steps.title: Load the user's quotes
steps.detail: The orders route checks the session, then queries quotes for that user ID. Existing identifiers and financial details are excluded from the recording.

steps.title: Link ERP invoices
steps.detail: The route reads the user's companyName, looks up a ledger with that name, and loads its sales. The supplied account showed no purchase invoices.

steps.title: Present separate tabs
steps.detail: The customer interface separates quote requests from formal purchase invoices. My Profile is explained without capturing personal fields.
